info.title: Ecwid REST API v3 responses read by wp-woo-idempotent-importer
info.description: Ecwid publishes no OpenAPI document. This subset is transcribed by hand from the field tables (and, where a field appears only there, the example responses) of the official reference at https://docs.ecwid.com/api-reference/rest-api/ (fetched 2026-10-16; each schema and operation cites its page): only the responses the Ecwid adapter reads. Paths are relative to `https://app.ecwid.com/api/v3/{storeId}`. Nested objects the adapter never reads are plain objects. Required properties are the identifiers and the fields the adapter cannot do without.
